listening.title: Handing over work before two weeks of leave

lines.speaker: Tuan (Team Leader)
lines.text: Linh, you start your leave next Monday. Is everything ready?

lines.speaker: Linh (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: Almost. I am writing a coverage plan for the two weeks now.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Team Leader)
lines.text: Who will be the backup contact for the supplier questions?

lines.speaker: Linh (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: Hoa will. I will brief her on Wednesday so she knows every deadline.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Team Leader)
lines.text: Does she have access rights to the shared budget folder?

lines.speaker: Linh (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: Not yet. Could you ask IT to add her before Thursday afternoon?

lines.speaker: Tuan (Team Leader)
lines.text: I will do that today. Are there any loose ends left?

lines.speaker: Linh (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: Two. The printing quote and the event photos, and both finish this week.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Team Leader)
lines.text: Good. Please leave a short checklist on the team page as well.

lines.speaker: Linh (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: It is already there, with the file names and the contact numbers.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Team Leader)
lines.text: And will you be reachable while you are away?

lines.speaker: Linh (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: By phone only, for urgent matters. My out-of-office reply explains the rest.
